# Toolchain and tools

`rha-baseline.json` owns the required version of every tool; the Rust toolchain is pinned in `rust-toolchain.toml`. `cargo xtask ci` records a check as `not_run` when its tool is absent (`tool_missing`) or at another version (`version_mismatch`).

| Tool | Status | Required | Used by | Install |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| rustc | required | 1.98.1 | L0.doctest | rustup toolchain install (reads rust-toolchain.toml) |
| rustfmt | required | 1.9.0-stable | L0.fmt | rustup component (rust-toolchain.toml) |
| clippy | required | 0.1.98 | L0.clippy | rustup component (rust-toolchain.toml) |
| cargo-nextest | required | 0.9.145 | L0.nextest | cargo install --locked cargo-nextest@0.9.145 |
| cargo-deny | required | 0.20.2 | L0.deny | cargo install --locked cargo-deny@0.20.2 |
| cargo-machete | required | 0.9.2 | L0.machete | cargo install --locked cargo-machete@0.9.2 |
| typos-cli | required | 1.50.2 | L0.typos | cargo install --locked typos-cli@1.50.2 |
| cargo-mutants | required | 27.1.0 | L1.mutation, L2.mutation | cargo install --locked cargo-mutants@27.1.0 |
| cargo-modules | required | 0.27.0 | H4.X-M01 | cargo install --locked cargo-modules@0.27.0 |
